name: Omar Hassan
discretionary_target: Synthesize across orders — highlight the outlier (ORD-8003 delayed while others delivered)

turns.text: Hi, I need to check on three orders: ORD-8001, ORD-8002, and ORD-8003. My ID is CUST-008.
Yes, that's correct. CUST-008. Go ahead and verify.
Okay, so the first two came through — that's good. But what's the story with ORD-8003? You said it's delayed. When should I expect that one?
Alright, and there's no way to speed that up or get an updated delivery estimate?
Oh, and my phone number changed ? it's 555-0809 now. Just mentioning it while we're talking.
Fair enough. So to recap: two delivered, one delayed until the end of the week. That gives me what I need. Thanks for pulling all three at once and walking me through them.
